maria: quick heads-up — i'm primary for the 10:00-18:00 shift but i've got to leave at ~15:30 for a doc appt. leaving a short handoff + runbook pointers here. TL;DR: if you get pages for 'api-embed-500' or latency spikes, follow checklist below and escalate if >3 alerts in 10m :warning:

kevin: can pick up primary from 15:30 until 16:45. sasha, can you cover 16:45-18:00?

sasha: yep can do 16:45-18:00. i'll be reachable on my cell.

incident-bot: [ALERT] P2 - api-embed-500 - 1765501248 - 7x errors in 5m (route: /v1/embeddings).

maria: incident-bot ^ -- if you see that, follow "Quick embed 500 triage" below. customer impact: some EU customers get 500s, US mostly ok.

alex: dropping a compact runbook and commands. use these first, they fix ~80% of cases we've seen. also ping ops-runbooks-bot for more links. :link:

ops-runbooks-bot: Quick runbooks:
- https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-embed-500
- https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-fallbacks
- https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-troubleshoot

alex: Quick embed 500 triage checklist (5-10 min):
1) Check alert context and rate: `alerts query --id api-embed-500 --last 10m`
2) Verify model routing fallback state: `curl -sS https://console.internal.redwood/routing/api-embed | jq .`
3) Look at recent deploys in last 30m: `deploybot history --service embedder --since 30m`
4) Check runtime errors on serving nodes: ```kubectl -n serving logs -l app=embedder --since=20m | grep -i error```
5) If KV cache saturation suspected, check hit rate: ```redis-cli -h kv-cache-prod INFO | grep -E "keyspace_hits|keyspace_misses"```
6) Quick mitigation: flip routing to stable fallback model: `curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/configure/routing -d '{"route":"/embeddings","variant":"stable-small"}'`  (this triggers fallback w/ lower throughput but lower error rate)

kevin: if we flip routing, warn clients via status page. i'll post an update in #incidents.

maria: escalation matrix if triage fails in 15m: ping alex (on-call lead) -> bryan (SRE manager) -> exec escalation. include incident id and customer list.

sasha: note on coverage gaps: between 16:45 and 17:10 i might have intermittent signal (airport). kevin please keep pager escalation wide until i'm confirmed in channel.

kevin: noted. i'll keep primary notifications and will forward pages to sasha when she confirms. if sasha doesn't ack in 5m after 16:45, i'll escalate to alex.

alex: also quick rollback if a deploy landed in last 30m and correlates with error bursts: `deploybot rollback --service embedder --to previous` — do this only after confirming traffic spike mapping.

maria: customer impact triage pointers:
- Check status page & incidents dashboard for correlated regions (eu-west-1 flagged).
- Run: `curl -I "https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings?region=eu-west-1"` to reproduce headers.
- Add customer-facing note if >=10% of requests fail for a paying customer: `statuspage create --component embeddings-eu --body "We are investigating intermittent 500s"`

incident-bot: new incident created INC-2026-045 by kevin at 1765501256.

maria: final handoff notes before i go:
- Primary til 15:30 -> kevin. secondary: sasha til 18:00.
- Most common fix: fallback routing + restart 1 pod if errors persist.
- Escalation: alex -> bryan. Include traces and sample request ids in ticket.
- Links: console route, runbooks (see ops-runbooks-bot).

kevin: acked. i'll post updates and timeline in #incidents and DM customers on the watchlist.

sasha: acked — i'll confirm once on mobile around 16:40.

maria: thanks team. leaving now — ping me if you need handover details. :pray:
